mapper.select: SELECT swno, itemdcd, swnm, mcorp, myear, ugubun, lgubun , lqty, rqty, lsdate, ledate, astate astate, iyear, price , aplace, apart, ACORP acorp, auser, acorpcd acorpcd , regid, regip, regdt, spec, attr1, attr2 FROM sw_master WHERE delyn='N' AND swno=#{swno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sw_master ( itemdcd, acorpcd, ugubun, swnm, astate, lgubun, lsdate, ledate, lqty, rqty, apart, auser, myear, mcorp , regid, regip, regdt, attr1, attr2, spec, price, delyn ) VALUES ( #{itemdcd}, #{acorpcd},#{ugubun}, #{swnm}, #{astate}, #{lgubun}, #{lsdate}, #{ledate}, #{lqty}, #{rqty}, #{apart}, #{auser}, #{myear}, #{mcorp} , #{regid}, #{regip}, now(), #{attr1}, #{attr2},#{spec},#{price}, 'N' )
